name: Softr
summary: Build custom AI business apps, client portals and internal tools without code. Connect Airtable, Google Sheets or your data and launch in an afternoon.
best_for: teams building internal tools, client portals or member apps on top of Airtable or Google Sheets without code
skip_if: you're building a public consumer app with unpredictable, high user counts — the per-user model works against you there
honest_knock: Builder seats are billed on top of the plan, and pricing counts builders and app users separately, so a public-facing app with a lot of end users gets expensive fast. Watch the overage rate as well as the plan: extra app users are $1 a month on Pro but $2 on Business, so the dearer plan meters growth at double the rate. It fits internal tools and client portals with a known audience, not an open signup.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-07 and again 2026-10-01) A free plan with unlimited apps, up to 3 builders, 5 app users, 5,000 database records, 500 workflow actions and 5 AI credits a month. Paid on yearly billing: Basic $19/month, Pro $99/month and Business $329/month, with Enterprise on custom limits; the pricing page opens on the Yearly tab and advertises two months off, so month-to-month costs more. App-user allowances are published per tier: Team 5 + Client 5 on Basic, Team 10 + Client 50 on Pro, Team 30 + Client 100 on Business, where Team users share a business email domain with one of your builders and everyone else counts as a Client user. Extra app users beyond the allowance start at $1/month on Pro and $2/month on Business. Extra builder seats are $5/month on Basic, $10 on Pro and $20 on Business, and builders can be added as app users free. Records run 50K / 500K / 1M and workflow actions 2.5K / 10K / 25K a month. Non-profits and education get a stated 50% discount. Refunds: in full within 14 days of a first monthly payment, 30 days of a first yearly one. AI credits run 10, 50 and 100 a month on Basic, Pro and Business (5 on Free), and add-on credits can be bought on every plan, Free included.
